listed_sector_signals.signal: Study is set in and applied to an operating cement plant (PTC) in East Java, Indonesia
listed_sector_signals.quote:
This pushes a cement plant (PTC) in East Java 
Indonesia to find a strategic management tool capable to give 
consistency of its energy conservation and efficiency

listed_sector_signals.signal: Energy management model empirically implemented/applied in the cement plant
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The EDIM model has been successfully applied by PTC to meet 
stakeholder’s demand for having reliable energy management 
system.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Cement industry described as energy-intensive with thermal and electrical energy production costs
listed_sector_signals.quote:
cement industry as an energy-intensive consuming considerable 
amount of energy in that 40% production cost from thermal and 
electrical energy [4] is to control its energy utilization.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Long-term energy objective example tied to cement plant equipment (tube mills, ID fan)
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Energy optimization through Installation of 
VSD on ID Fan Tube Mill to reduce electricity load at 26 kW per 
tube mill out of 6 tube mills.

one_line: Qualitative case study designing and implementing a strategic energy management system (EDIM, based on ISO 50001 and the Pearce/Robinson model) in an operating cement plant (PTC) in East Java, Indonesia.
